briefdescription.para: Defines the behaviour of frame allocation.
Allocates a single AVVkFrame and initializes everything as 0.
Returns the optimal per-plane Vulkan format for a given sw_format, one for each plane.

detaileddescription.para: For user-allocated pools, AVHWFramesContext.pool must return AVBufferRefs with the data pointer set to an AVVkFrame.
